name: Maria Lopez

text.trigger: A player controls Maria Lopez and is not exiled.
text.vignette: The school hallways are silent when Maria steps in, but the silence turns out to be hiding a room of hungry children who have been fending for themselves. She can bring them something now or empty the pantry for them and leave.

options.bring-them-food: Maria is placed at the School (not a move). Remove 3 food from the supply and search the School deck for any 3 cards, adding them to your hand.
options.open-the-pantry: Maria is placed at the School (not a move). Search the School deck for every Food card and remove them all from the game.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #8; The first option needs 3 food in the supply, otherwise the second is forced.
